_meta.description: Hand-curated Gregory-Aland uncials overlapping the Greek NT timeline window. Not in the Liste papyri export (docID 10000–19999).

witnesses.contents: Complete Greek Bible (OT + NT) plus Epistle of Barnabas and Shepherd of Hermas; NT and much of OT extant
witnesses.date_note: Paleographic range IV century, commonly placed mid-4th c. (c. 330–360 CE in many handbooks). Liste and Tischendorf tradition; not a point date.
witnesses.find_place: Saint Catherine's Monastery, Mount Sinai, Egypt
witnesses.find_year_or_note: Discovered for Western scholarship by Constantin von Tischendorf, 1844 (monastery had long possessed the codex)
witnesses.current_institution: Dispersed: British Library (London), Universitätsbibliothek Leipzig, Saint Catherine's Monastery (Sinai), Russian National Library (few leaves)
witnesses.translation: "Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name." (Matt 6:9, KJV — Lord's Prayer leaf)

known_variants.significance: One of the witnesses for the long ending of Mark.
Alexandrian omission pattern shared with Vaticanus and early papyri.

witnesses.contents: Greek Bible (LXX + NT): Matt–2 Thess, Heb 1:1–9:13, Jas–Jude; lacks Pastorals, Phlm, Rev; Heb 9:14+ in later minuscule hand
witnesses.date_note: INTF Liste: IV (300–399 CE). Paleographic range for the original majuscule hand; not a point date.
witnesses.find_place: Provenance before Vatican Library is unknown
witnesses.find_year_or_note: In the Vatican Library by at least the 15th century (catalogued 1475)
witnesses.translation: "God, who at sundry times and in divers manners spake in time past unto the fathers by the prophets…" (Heb 1:1, KJV)

known_variants.significance: Benchmark Alexandrian majuscule; close to early papyri in many readings.
Shared omission with Sinaiticus and 𝔓66/𝔓75.
